bindings.caption: Heat EPFS powder and water in reactor. temperature: 180 ℃. duration: 3 h. Recipe-level reported vessel: polytetrafluoroethylene lined reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Filter the brown solution using polyether sulfone membrane. duration: 15 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: polytetrafluoroethylene lined reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Centrifuge the solution at 10,000 rpm for 15 min. duration: 15 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: polytetrafluoroethylene lined reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Filter the supernatant using needle type syringe filter. Recipe-level reported vessel: polytetrafluoroethylene lined reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Dialyze the solution using 2000 d dialysis bag for 2 days. duration: 2 d. Recipe-level reported vessel: polytetrafluoroethylene lined reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.
